data.description:
Greetings My Lord ! 👑

I hath heard thou art quite the dungeon connoisseur, so i maketh this bawbling passthrough system where thee can buildeth thy owneth dungeon using a variety of traps and items, as well as lodging waypoints to giveth goals to the dungeon seekers. 🏰

What can I expect from my dungeon??
# -
# TURN YOUR HOME INTO A DUNGEON
The dungeon foundation is generated from your Meta rooms setup! Use the menu to load, design and save your dungeon once you've built it.
{897653955802688}

# SET DEADLY TRAPS AND QUESTS
Plenty of traps and quest items to place around your home. Keys and doors, plots anf treasures, deadly pits, swinging axes, skeletons!
{884487527165107}

# DARE TO ADVENTURE THROUGH IT

Once you are ready, put down the controllers and enjoy full hand tracking as you journey through your dungeon.
{836602965118342}

# FIND THE TREASURE!

Can you go deep enough into the dungeon to retrieve the treasure?

{1731354897597483}

changelog.change_log:
Sire, please find all the release notes here! If you want a bit more details on what I did do check the posts on the game store page.

Version 0.33
- A new menu option under edit called "room modifiers" where you can make the floor lower and the ceiling higher!
- 2 new items: wood beam and stone floor to go with the new lower floor mode.
- Optimization: only the room you are in will be enabled. No more rendering rooms you aren't currently in!
- A redesigned save system (backend but still worth noting, work is work ^^);
- Added a "NEW" indicator on new features in the menu. To find the latest stuff quicker Sire!
- Saved dungeons order is inverted now so the latest dungeons appear at the top. No more scrolling if you have 100s of dungeons like I do...
- Fixed rendering order issues in some areas, like portals, hands and holes.
- Fixed where the (purple) dungeon portal spawns, as they previously would spawn in the center of the room. If your room was L shaped, that center may be out of view.
- Duplicate now works on lava and skeletons.
- Fixed issue with pointer toggling between menu and world items. It was sometimes hard to click the tabs without interacting with the dungeon walls at the same time.

Version 0.32
- Added windows that see into the exerior bleak world!
- Changed room portal design, added frame and is blocked off if there's no connecting room setup.
- Added loading screen on menu when loading or starting a new dungeon.

Version 0.31
- 90FPS on Quest3/3S!
- Redesigned the menu from the ground up.
- You can now easily switch between left/right handed in the new menu settings.
- Settings also include toggling controller button tips!
- Added 3D controllers while in the menu for easier visiblity, and for tips to make sense.
- Added function to duplicate items directly, no need to keep going back to the menu!
- The dungeon foundation now includes all rooms instead of just current room. 
- A portal is placed on your doors that lead to another setup room, though make sure your physical doors are open ^^. (Try blocking access to the portal with the Door & Key quest item!)
- Added particles effects to certain items like the key, treasure and waypoints.
- The app is now boundaryless, which means you no longer need see or setup a boundary to use it. Really helps when going through multiple rooms!
- There's also a tab in the menu with some of my other games, check them out!
- You can no longer portal to the current dungeon, a message will warn you that you are selecting the same dungeon.
- Creating a new dungeon doesn't increment the dungeon number until it's been saved.
- Removed the limit to how many Dungeons you can save.
- When you start a dungeon adventure, it'll be automatically saved.
- You now have to place the Starting point
- Ceiling traps now snap to the ceiling so it's easier to drag and place them correctly.

Sire! We're back with a mighty update.

v0.22.5
- Fixed issue with Dungeon Portals where going through a portal would spawn the next dungeon, but it would be empty. (Thanks to @BlackBeard)

v0.22.4
- Finally fixed the MASSIVE bug that moved/distorted/changed the scene items if you removed your device and it went to sleep. It was definitely annoying when trying to pass your dungeon over to friends and family. Enjoy hassly free dungeon dwelling now!

v0.22.3
- Meta Spaces is now mandatory for the initial setup. So once you've outlined your walls, and any furniture on your Quest, Dungeon Maker will automatically generate a dungeon framework based on this. Then you can customise to your liking.
- Color assets for all! Everything is now full color, looks really nice on Quest 3! :)
- A better selection UI, with outlines and names. So you know what you are selecting and dragging around.
- And many other quality of life improvements.

Quick tip:
- I'm going to build a sub menu for quick options, but for now one option which you'll want to use is setting the Meta Scene generated assets like walls and furniture into occlusion. So you can see your real walls/floor/ceiling/couch. For now to do this simply point at a wall for example and pull the grip trigger like you want to grab it. This will toggle between your real wall and the generated wall. So feel free to do this on all the Meta Spaces assets to reveal your home!

Known issues:
- If the device goes to sleep, the Meta Scene breaks when you return. So make sure you save your dungeons, you can just load your save again if the scene breaks after sleep. This shouldn't affect passing the device to friends around you, as the device takes 10secs to go to sleep (or if you press the power button). Will issue a fix very soon!

Sire! 
This is currently in beta for a reason, as I'm still working on polishing. It works, but things may break or not function sometimes. So be patient as I work on updates regularly Sire!

Working on this big update brining plenty of improved features:
- Full color!
- Uses Meta Spaces so the dungeon template is generate from your home layout automatically. 
- Improved UI and interaction, can see more clearly what you are currently pointing at and how to select. 
- Larger fonts to make everything more legible.
- And many other quality of life improvements.

Known issues:
- If you try to recenter, everything breaks. And I mean everything. So what I've done for now to make things less worse is if you try to recenter it'll just generate a new template from your Spaces. Though you shouldn't recenter, there's no point. It's all spacially anchored! ^^
- Seems like if you reboot your headset and load a dungeon you saved, the items you placed are not in correct place. It works fine if you don't reboot. If this happens for now just use the MOVE ALL button to move all the items back to original pose.

- New "Enemies" category in the menu, with two types of enemies to start things off:
- - Skeleton Patrol: Will walk between two points. If the player goes near the skeleton, it will attack!
- - Skeleton Guard: Will guard a specific area. If the player enters that area the skeleton will walk towards the player, and attack if they meet.
- Adjusted grab height for floor items so you can properly select items on top of each other.
- Updated various bits of audio, some UI elements and anchor design for items.

- New menu category: Soundscapes. You can now add various audio layers to your dungeon to make it sound more like...a dungeon! 
- Added a new "Pillar Of Instructions" when you first launch the game. It contains a breakdown of how to start building your first dungeon.
- Improved various item and trap sounds.
